searchText: <RobertoSaltini> Hi all, I was thinking that it might be possible to test the performance of PQ signature aggregation without using any consensus protocol. Aside from simplifying things, this would ensure that the performance of PQ sig. aggregation is measured in isolation and is not influence by other components such as consensus. Here is how I think this could be achieved. - Time is divided into slots as usual. - We have an injective function `m(s)` to map a slot `s` to a message. - At the beginning of each slot `s`, each node signs the the message `m(s)`. - Aggregation is then performed during slot `s`. - At the beginning of the next slot `s+1`, each node records data about the quality of the aggregates that they received. - The information recorded by each node is then aggregated together. <unnawut> @asqyzeron Thanks for your early feedback on https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanSpec/pull/5 I'm going to try out the union type for optional fields. @gr3999 If you could have a look at this PR that'd be great. The justifications dict becomes a List + Bitlist 4. As you do make a good point There is a general ssz transaction EIP that it should be coordinated with. https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6404 +1 That EIP does not address new signatures, so there is only a little overlap. But I do like the signature algo field. excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<RobertoSaltini> Hi all, I was thinking that it might be possible to test the performance of PQ signature aggregation without using any consensus protocol. 

Aside from simplifying things, this would ensure that the performance of PQ sig. aggregation is measured in isolation and is not influence by other components such as consensus.

Here is how I think this could be achieved.
- Time is divided into slots as usual.
- We have an injective function `m(s)` to map a slot `s` to a message.
- At the beginning of each slot `s`, each node signs the the message `m(s)`.
- Aggregation is then performed during slot `s`.
- At the beginning of the next slot `s+1`, each node records data about the quality of the aggregates that they received.
- The information recorded by each node is then aggregated together.

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<unnawut> @asqyzeron Thanks for your early feedback on https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanSpec/pull/5 I'm going to try out the union type for optional fields.

@gr3999 If you could have a look at this PR that'd be great. I think the major points for review are:

1. `VALIDATOR_REGISTRY_LIMIT: 4096` same as zeam's impl

2. `MAX_HISTORICAL_BLOCK_HASHES: 262144` so it's enough for 12 days with 4s slot time

3. The justifications dict becomes a List + Bitlist

4. The rest are minor like `str -> Bytes32`, `int -> uint64`, removing `state.config`, etc.

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: I think we should adopt SSZ as the transaction encoding for EL PQ signatures.  One less encoding type for lean Ethereum.

excerpts.author: _shemnon

excerpts.author: _shemnon
